baseline_reproduction: With an authored Rice 12 draft, a new Confirm 12 final arriving before the deferred read-back completed saved Rice 12. The negative regression failed on the unmodified baseline and passed on the candidate.
changes: A new confirmation final delivered during read-back cannot commit; the pending count is held for review.
A newer correction cancels and supersedes the old spoken reply. A stale completion or rejection callback cannot reopen capture or cancel the newer reply.
Unavailable spoken read-back is not treated as completed speech. Deliberately disabled speech retains the visual-review path.

The app can export a private interaction report with local event timings, action history, counts, holds and served-asset hashes. It contains transcript text but no recorded audio, configured access code or provider credentials. Export itself uploads nothing.

ci.scope: Actual tracked source and Chromium/app/worklet/downloads, using generated silence and mocked provider/speech callbacks. Not a physical-microphone, live ASR or human evaluation.

limits: This guards delivery-time ordering while a read-back is pending; it does not prove that the human actually listened or acoustically timestamp all speech.
Report asset hashes identify bytes served at export time, not a cryptographic attestation of the code that executed earlier.
Two previous human recording replays remain failed. A genuine interactive microphone/read-back/retry session is still required before claiming human task success.
